title: An Open Letter To My Wife
subtitle: Remember to file your comment with the DEA!
text:
It is time, honey. We talked about this last night. You asked me to remind yo

You need to file a public comment with the DEA about the proposed update regarding telehealth prescribing of controlled substances.

It doesn't allow for schedule II substances to be prescribed without an in person visit. It has a bunch of other elaborate rules that are not very good. it could be a lot better, and I have it on good authority that the DEA is interested in reading all of our public comments as they were mandated to do by law. And if we get enough of them in, maybe they'll change something.

Go to regulations.gov.

In the search bar, type: DEA telemedicine…

Enter your comment in the free text field, and you can also attached documentation if you have any of that.

Remember thousands of patients getting buprenorphine by Telehealth for the past three years are going to die if you don't do this. And children who need stimulant medication if you don't do this. And children who need stimulant medication for their ADHD? Also out of luck. And some trans humans? Not going to be able to get testosterone. In some states, epilepsy medicine, like gabapentin, is also controlled.

You are welcome!

—Owen Scott Muir, M.D.
